rows.Bloom: Carmine-pink. Reverse veined light yellow (veiné au revers jaune léger). Strong fragrance. 28 to 30 petals. Average diameter 5". Very large, very double, borne mostly solitary, high-centered bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 2' to 39" (60 to 100cm). Width: 20" to 2' (50 to 60cm).
